query: Equinix Q2 2026 revenue $2.625 billion year-over-year growth AI demand
normalized: 2 2026 625 ai billion demand equinix growth over q2 revenue year

output.content:
Equinix reported Q2 2026 revenue of **$2.625 billion** for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, up **16% year over year** on both a reported and normalized constant-currency basis. [[1]] 

The headline growth included both strong underlying demand and one-time xScale fees: recurring revenue was **$2.377 billion**, versus **$2.143 billion** a year earlier, while non-recurring revenue rose to **$248 million** from **$113 million**. [[1]] 

Thus, recurring revenue grew about **10.9% YoY**, indicating that most of the underlying growth remained robust even excluding the unusually large non-recurring contribution. [[1]] 

AI demand appears to be a meaningful operational driver rather than merely a narrative: annualized gross bookings increased **23% YoY**, backlog reached a record, and Equinix added a record **9,700 net interconnections** in the quarter. [[2]] 

Management said customer demand was broad-based and growing, and specifically positioned Equinix to serve enterprise networking, cloud, and AI-infrastructure requirements. [[2]] 

The key analytical caveat is that the **16%** total-revenue growth rate should not be treated as fully recurring, because the company explicitly attributed part of it to one-time xScale fees; the recurring-revenue trajectory and bookings/interconnection metrics are cleaner indicators of sustained AI-led demand. [[1]] [[2]]
